paper_title: From Sparse to Dense Representations in Open Channel Flow Images with Convolutional Neural Networks

paper_title: Indoor Airflow Field Reconstruction Using Physics-Informed Neural Network

paper_title: Remaining Useful Lifetime Estimation for Discrete Power Electronic Devices Using Physics-Informed Neural Network
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 332 states that its data are NASA PCoE Data Set 8, Insulated-Gate Bipolar Transistor Accelerated Aging, and cites the legacy NASA repository location. NASA's current PCoE entry 8 and Open Data record preserve the same dataset identity and metadata. PRL000068 is verified despite relocation of the Stage-1 URL.
